comments.author: RangerB
comments.body: If it needs Commerce/Merchant point, it is best to make and take jeweled turbans. Usually, it only needs 20 to 30. Any changes to the port's environment will occur on Mondays. However, you will see the points increase a few hours after you deliver the jeweled turbans or anything else needed to bring the port's points back to 40k/40k/40k. For some reason, the adventure side is usually okay. It is the commerce and/or armament points that are usually lacking.
